name: inprocess-obi-axi4lite-axiluart-f5-refused
description: One Ibex OBI CPU reaches one real AXI4-Lite ZipCPU UART that declares the four F5 facts. The F5 gate is asked whether this host has ever run an F5 cycle under the AXI4-Lite target protocol; the case is refused by name before any model runs.
notes: This scenario is a question to the F5 protocol gate, not evidence of an F5 run.

The target is the same wbuart RTL behind the real AXI4-Lite MMIO bridge (configs/peripherals/zipcpu_axiluart), so the F5 declaration and the device facts are identical to the Wishbone scenario: only the target protocol differs.
